issues: whether the federal limitation period applies to a claim by the federal Crown to recover an overpayment from a former employee, or whether the provincial limitation period governs the claim

overpayment of approximately $7,700 resulting from pay system errors after paid sick leave credits were exhausted

funds were drawn from the federal consolidated revenue fund
debt is owed to a federal entity
employer argues the six-year federal limitation period applies
